description: This file defines the FilterInterpreter class, responsible for interpreting and converting filter structures into SQL clauses within the SuiteCRM application's JSON API v1 filters module.

classes.name: FilterInterpreter
classes.description: Encapsulates logic for interpreting complex filter structures and transforming them into SQL queries or filter objects within the SuiteCRM JSON API framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FilterInterpreter with the container dependencies, setting up static operator instances.

methods.name: isFilterByPreMadeName
methods.description: Checks if a given filter structure matches a predefined filter by its name.

methods.name: isFilterById
methods.description: Determines if the filter structure is a filter by identifier.

methods.name: isFilterByAttributes
methods.description: Checks if the filter structure represents attribute-based filters in the format expected.

methods.name: getFilterByPreMadeName
methods.description: Retrieves the SQL clause corresponding to a predefined filter name.

methods.name: getFilterById
methods.description: Retrieves a filter object based on ID filter structure.

methods.name: getFilterByAttributes
methods.description: Converts attribute filters into SQL conditions, handling bean and field validation.

methods.name: toSqlFilter
methods.description: Constructs a SQL snippet for a given field operation using the specified table and operator.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Resolves a string operator into an OperatorInterface object from the available operator collections.

methods.name: isCustomField
methods.description: Determines if a given field is a custom field for a specific module.

methods.name: toCustomTable
methods.description: Appends '_cstm' to the table name if it doesn't already end with it, indicating a custom table.
